units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:6">Targ. Job VI, 6</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:2:10">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> top (Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ bot. <he>סגין</he>, corr. acc.) <he>כגון ב׳ ומרגליתא</he> as e.g. one swearing of an egg that it was a pearl (as an instance of <he>שבועת שקר</he>).
<cite ref="Yoma 69b:12">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ בת יומא</he> a fresh egg of the same day; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בֵּיעִין</he>, <he>בֵּיעַיָּא</he>, <he>בֵּיעֵי</he>, <he>בֵּע׳</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 22:6">Targ. O. Deut. XXII, 6</cite> (Y. <he>ביעיין</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 6b:12">Bets. 6ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>ב׳ דפחיא</he> the eggs of a cackling hen, opp. those found in the killed hen.
<cite ref="Beitzah 6b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>ב׳ דדיכרא</he> eggs from a hen impregnated by a cock, opp. <he>ב׳ דספנא מארעא</he> by friction on the ground.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>; a. fr.—<he>זבן בכל בֵּיעָתָא</he> to buy (the hen) with all the eggs, i.e. to do a thing thoroughly.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:7">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>; Ruth R. (introd.) to I, 2; Esth. R. beg. <cite ref="B00756"><he>ביתא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="B00679"><he>בֵּיצָה</he></cite>.
